ผม|pǒm นามสกุล|naam-sà-gun บราวน์|braao
จอห์น|jɔɔn บราวน์|braao หรือ|rʉ̌ʉ ครับ|kráp

t.pt: ชื่อ é o primeiro nome
t.en: ชื่อ is the given name

e.pt: Na Tailândia as pessoas são chamadas pelo primeiro nome, com คุณ antes: คุณประภาส. O sobrenome é นามสกุล. Analogia: é como no Brasil chamar o médico de 'doutor Pedro', não 'doutor Milken'.
e.en: Thais are addressed by their given name with คุณ before it. The family name is นามสกุล.

notas.ex: คุณ|kun ประภาส|bprà-pâat

t.pt: อะไร fica no lugar da resposta
t.en: อะไร sits where the answer goes

e.pt: Pergunta: คุณชื่ออะไร. Resposta: ผมชื่อจอห์น. A palavra interrogativa ocupa a posição da informação que falta.
e.en: Question: คุณชื่ออะไร. Answer: ผมชื่อจอห์น. The question word takes the slot of the missing information.

notas.ex: คุณ|kun ชื่อ|chʉ̂ʉ อะไร|à-rai

t.pt: Sim e não: ใช่ / ไม่ใช่ / เปล่า

e.pt: ใช่ไหม no fim pede confirmação ('não é?'). Responde-se ใช่ (é) ou ไม่ใช่ (não é); เปล่า nega com mais força. Analogia: ใช่ไหม é estender a mão esperando um 'toca aqui'.
e.en: ใช่ไหม asks 'isn't it?'. Answer ใช่ (yes) or ไม่ใช่ (no); เปล่า denies more strongly.

t.pt: Pedidos com กรุณา ... ได้ไหม
t.en: Requests: กรุณา ... ได้ไหม

e.pt: กรุณา abre um pedido polido e ได้ไหม no fim pergunta se a pessoa pode fazê-lo. Analogia: é o 'poderia ..., por favor?' em duas peças, uma em cada ponta da frase.
e.en: กรุณา opens a polite request and ได้ไหม at the end asks whether the person can do it.
